'''Wang Xiaomo''' ({{zh|s=王小谟|t=王小謨|p=Wāng Xiǎomó}}; 11 November 1938 – 6 March 2023)<ref>[https://www.guancha.cn/economy/2023_03_06_682856.shtml “中国预警机之父”王小谟院士逝世，享年84岁] {{in lang|zh}}</ref> was a Chinese radar engineer who has been hailed as the "Father of [[Airborne early warning and control|Airborne Warning and Control System]] in China".<ref>{{cite news|author=Luo Sha |url=https://news.sohu.com/20130720/n382156288.shtml |script-title=zh:“中国预警机之父”王小谟：一辈子只做一件事 |newspaper=Sohu |date=2013-07-20 |language=zh}}</ref> Wang had been engaged in the research and design of radar systems for 50 years.<ref>{{cite news|title=Wang Xiaomo, father of Chinese AWACS|url=http://beijing.china.org.cn/2014-12/01/content_34194543.htm|accessdate=8 May 2018|work=china.org.cn|date=1 December 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://mil.sohu.com/20130118/n363902864.shtml |script-title=zh:中国预警机之父王小谟：从事雷达研制已50余年 |newspaper=Sohu |date=2013-01-18 |language=zh}}</ref>

Wang was a delegate to the 9th and [[10th National People's Congress]].

==Biography==
Wang was born in [[Jinshan District]] of [[Shanghai]], on November 11, 1938. He graduated from the [[Beijing Institute of Technology]].

In 1969, Wang went to [[Guizhou]] to form the No. 38 Research Institute, a research agency attached to the Ministry of Electronics Industry. Wang was elevated to president in 1986. In 1990, Wang served as chief engineer of the [[Early-warning radar|early warning airplane]], to which he made great contributions.{{Citation needed|date=March 2023}} In 1995, Wang was elected a fellow of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].

Wang won China's top science award, the [[Highest Science and Technology Award]], in 2012.<ref>{{cite news|title=Chinese scientists awarded top prize|url=http://usa.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2013-01/18/content_16141407.htm|accessdate=8 May 2018|work=Chinadaily|date=18 January 2013}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 1985 and 2010 First prize for National Technological Progress
* 1997 Science and Technology Award of the Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation
* 2012 [[Highest Science and Technology Award]]
